arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown: {/c}{c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
{if:SF_10}Steel yourself for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds, increasing your Maximum Life by {c_number}[({SF_14} * {SF_35})*100|%|]{/c} and preventing your Life from being reduced below {c_number}1{/c}. You are healed to {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|1%|]{/c} Life when {c_important}Iron Skin{/c} expires.{/if}{if:SF_19}Steel yourself for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds, increasing your Maximum Life by {c_number}[({SF_14} * {SF_35})*100|%|]{/c} and reflecting Iron Shrapnel when attacked, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_SHRAPNEL_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage and inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_BLEED_DOT}{/c} bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_BLEED_DOT}{/c} seconds.{/if}{if:SF_7}Steel yourself for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds, increasing your Maximum Life by {c_number}[({SF_14} * {SF_35})*100|%|]{/c} and gaining a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} that absorbs {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}({shield:BARRIER}){/c} in damage.{/if}

{if:SF_7}{icon:bullet, 1.2} Barrier potency {icon:arrow, 1.2} {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|1%|]{/c}{/if}{if:Mod.UpgradeB}{icon:bullet, 1.2} Heal Amount {icon:arrow, 1.2} {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|1%|]{/c}{/if}{if:Mod.UpgradeC}{icon:bullet, 1.2} Iron Shrapnel Damage {icon:arrow, 1.2} {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_SHRAPNEL_TOOLTIP}{/c}
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Bleeding Damage {icon:arrow, 1.2} {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_BLEED_DOT}{/c}{/if}

{c_important}Iron Skin{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:BARRIER}{/c} seconds and its {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} absorbs {c_number}[{SF_12} * 100|%|]{/c} more of your Maximum Life.
{c_important}Iron Skin{/c} also grants {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} and enemies that hit you are Knocked back.

{c_important}Iron Skin{/c} no longer grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c}, but your Life cannot be reduced below {c_number}1{/c} for the duration and you are healed to {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|1%|]{/c} Life when {c_important}Iron Skin{/c} expires.

{c_important}Iron Skin{/c} no longer grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c}. Instead you reflect {c_important}{u}Iron Shrapnel{/u}{/c} when attacked, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_SHRAPNEL_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage and inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_BLEED_DOT}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_BLEED_DOT}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Iron Skin's{/c} duration is tripled.
{c_important}Iron Skin{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Enemies attacking you while {c_important}Iron Skin{/c} is active become {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_31}]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Iron Skin{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_36}]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} when cast.
Increase the Maximum Life granted from {c_important}Iron Skin{/c} to {c_number}[{SF_14}*(1+{SF_33})*100|%|]{/c}.
